area: quality of model judgements (probabilistic; LLM-judged against evals/rubrics/model_units.md)
note: These cases are defined but not executed: no judge is configured, and the thresholds are TBD until baselines exist (OQ-11). run_evals.py reports them as not_executed, never as passed.

cases.description: The protocol evaluator finds the planted framework misfit (a PICO forced on a methods topic) and its verdict agrees with its findings.
Query verdicts: an off-anchor query is judged replan with a reason grounded in the signals, not accepted.
Screening: every score is preceded by a verbatim quote; inclusion agrees with a labelled set (agreement threshold TBD).
Deconstruction: claims keep the source's strength and scope; no paraphrased quote; nothing from other papers.
Collision judgements: planted conflict, boundary and incommensurable pairs are judged correctly with the differing axes named.
Research questions survive the four screens honestly; a settled question is not marked ready.
The hypothesis form follows the primary collision (derivation table) and rivals come from the field's accounts.
Attack plan: each target is a real sentence of its source, the wording is not stronger than the source, and the landing leaf exists.
Packaging introduces no decision absent from P1-P4 and promises nothing untested (blind restatement matches).
